## lmw api get

GET an internal API path and print the JSON

```
lmw api get PATH [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw api get /me
  lmw api get /feed/updatesV2 -p count=10 -p q=chronFeed -p start=0
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help                help for get
  -p, --param stringArray   query parameter as KEY=VALUE (repeatable)
```

### Options inherited from parent commands

```
      --json      print JSON output
  -v, --verbose   show debug logs, including every API request
```
